verdict.rationale: Refunds on agent-placed orders can be handled via Stripe's standard Refunds API/Dashboard, and agent orders are traceable through checkout.session.completed events tagged with agent_details for filtering by agent in the Dashboard, plus MCP-mediated refunds require human approval tokens. However, there's no agent-order-specific refund API, no documented refund status webhooks tied to agent attribution, and no dispute-handling workflow specific to agentic orders. Missing for 10: dedicated refund/dispute API or webhook scoped to agent orders, documented programmatic refund initiation tied to SPT/agent_details, and independent/hands-on confirmation of refund tracking working end-to-end for agent orders.
